Translation_to_English:
Maurice Nathan. He is not at the exchange; if I see him I will tell him to come and visit you.
Samuel … Laboun. I wrote to you yesterday about this and I wait to hear from you about …
Zek writes to you this evening regarding an order from Hassan Cherif.
Hussein Sani. For the ticket and the invoice for the 50 … The receiver will return.
Abdel Zaki. For the fork for the 10 kg … contained in the crate … and he will sign the collection.
Hussein Sani. I sold it to him and ask you to ship it to me.
14/6 – 25 francs …
Enrique Mitraile. He must pay for the crate; cost 18/20; this wine we received at 122 francs; you will clear the said crate from customs.
Market. As you can see from my sales, the market is still calm and there is nothing new to expect for an improvement.
I do not see any sugar from “Cuba sale” going out; is there a reason?
With nothing further … best regards.
